exposure: History of spinal fusion for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis
cohort: 53 adolescent idiopathic scoliosis patients who underwent posterior spinal fusion and subsequently had a pregnancy and childbirth
finding: AIS patients who underwent spinal fusion had a higher rate of cesarean delivery and lower rate of epidural/spinal anesthesia during vaginal birth compared to national averages.
mod_finding: The study found a higher rate of cesarean delivery in AIS patients with previous spinal fusion compared to the national average.
